base.name: GIF89a core image stream (CompuServe GIF89a Specification, 1990) -- Logical Screen Descriptor, Global Color Table, Image Descriptors/Local Color Tables/raster data (the structure GIF87a already had), plus the whole-document set-snapshot/no-mutation surface. The shared reader/writer for the whole file lives here; the extension-block subsets reuse it (family-module pattern) rather than duplicating it.

graphic-control.name: GIF89a Graphic Control Extension (Sec. 23) -- disposal method, user-input flag, transparent-color flag and index, delay time: a self-contained optional block (label 0x21 0xF9) preceding an image.

comment.name: GIF89a Comment Extension (Sec. 24) -- a self-contained optional block (label 0x21 0xFE) of plain-text sub-blocks with no rendering effect.

application.name: GIF89a Application Extension (Sec. 26) -- a self-contained optional block (label 0x21 0xFF) identifying an application plus its opaque sub-blocks, including the de-facto NETSCAPE2.0 looping sub-block.
